//: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT. Every string describes what belongs in it. Replace the values, keep the keys. A collection is a body of work outside interior design — ceramics, furniture, textiles. Add a new one by copying an entry and changing the slug.
title: Collection title
subtitle: Subtitle — one line about the body of work
summary: Summary — one or two sentences. Shown on the studio index and used as the social share description.
statement: Statement paragraph. What the work is, how it is made, what it is after.

cover.alt: Alt text — describe what the photograph actually shows.

pieces.//: A piece with a photograph only. Clicking it opens the lightbox.
pieces.title: Piece title
pieces.description: Description — optional note about the piece.

pieces.//: A piece with a 3D model. The viewer replaces the photograph but downloads nothing until the visitor presses 'View in 3D'. Objects are where 3D earns its keep: a photograph fixes one viewpoint, and the point of a thrown vessel is its profile in the round. models/example.glb does not exist yet, so the viewer shows its fallback message until you add one — or delete the 'scene' object to leave this as a photograph.
pieces.title: Piece title

scene.alt: Alt text — the only description a screen reader gets, since a canvas has no readable content.

poster.alt: Alt text for the still shown before the model loads.
